options: To make assets disappear from the balance sheet immediately
To increase a business's reported cash balance
To spread a long-term asset's cost across the periods it actually benefits, following the matching principle
To avoid ever reporting the original cost of an asset
questions.explain: Depreciation applies the matching principle to long-term assets: it spreads cost across the years the asset is actually used.

questions.q: What is the formula for straight-line annual depreciation?
options: Cost divided by Salvage Value
Cost multiplied by Useful Life
Salvage Value divided by Useful Life
(Cost - Salvage Value) divided by Useful Life
questions.explain: Straight-line depreciation divides the depreciable base (Cost minus Salvage Value) evenly across the useful life.

questions.q: Cobalt Courier Services buys a $40,000 truck with an 8-year useful life and a $4,000 salvage value. What is the annual straight-line depreciation?
options: $5,000 per year
$4,500 per year
$4,000 per year
$36,000 per year

questions.q: In the annual depreciation journal entry, which account is credited?
options: Accumulated Depreciation, a contra-asset account
Cash
Equipment, directly reducing its recorded cost
Depreciation Expense
questions.explain: Depreciation credits Accumulated Depreciation (a contra-asset) rather than reducing the Equipment account's original cost directly.

questions.q: What does the Oracle Fusion Assets module do, in relation to the concepts in this lesson?
options: It eliminates the need for depreciation calculations entirely
It only tracks cash, not long-term assets
It tracks each fixed asset's depreciation schedule and automatically generates the correct depreciation journal entries period after period
It replaces the matching principle with a cash-based approach
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion Assets automates exactly the depreciation calculation and journal entry process this lesson covers, across potentially thousands of assets.
